system_name: MiniMax H3 Frozen Architectural Workflow Catalog

01_Exterior_Hero.name: Exterior Hero Reveal
01_Exterior_Hero.recommended_motion: slow cinematic reveal / slow push in (small amplitude, slow speed)
01_Exterior_Hero.known_limitations: single-frame geometry limitation - avoid dramatic orbit / large perspective change
01_Exterior_Hero.purpose: Architectural presentation video revealing building facade
01_Exterior_Hero.recommended_prompt_template: Architectural visualization of {scene}, slow cinematic push-in shot with 35mm architectural lens, twilight dusk illumination, warm 3500K interior glow through curtainwall, preserve building geometry, photorealistic architectural photography, 4k ultra detailed
01_Exterior_Hero.camera_style: slow cinematic push-in shot with 35mm architectural lens
01_Exterior_Hero.recommended_prompt: Architectural visualization of {scene}, slow cinematic push-in shot with 35mm architectural lens, twilight dusk illumination, warm 3500K interior glow through curtainwall, preserve building geometry, photorealistic architectural photography, no text or logos

02_Day_Night_Transition.name: Day Night Atmosphere Transition
02_Day_Night_Transition.recommended_motion: static shot / nearly static with extremely subtle drift
02_Day_Night_Transition.known_limitations: requires matched DAY+NIGHT pair (same architecture, near-identical camera); lighting transformation over scene regeneration
02_Day_Night_Transition.purpose: Architectural atmosphere transformation from day to night
02_Day_Night_Transition.recommended_prompt_template: Time-lapse animation of {scene} facade transitioning from golden hour sunset to twilight night, warm interior lights gradually illuminating windows, preserve building geometry
02_Day_Night_Transition.recommended_prompt: Time-lapse animation of {scene} facade transitioning from golden hour sunset to twilight night, warm interior lights gradually illuminating windows, preserve building geometry, no text or logos

03_Material_Detail.name: Material Texture Showcase
03_Material_Detail.recommended_motion: static shot with extremely subtle drift (micro motion)
03_Material_Detail.known_limitations: local material softening under generative motion (LOCAL_MATERIAL_SOFTENING_UNDER_GENERATIVE_MOTION); material fidelity over motion
03_Material_Detail.purpose: Architectural material detail and texture focus
03_Material_Detail.recommended_prompt_template: Tactile architectural detail focus on {material} facade, 35mm architectural lens, soft daylight filtering, macro architectural photography, preserve building geometry, 4k ultra detailed
03_Material_Detail.camera_style: close-up, shallow depth of field, slow lateral move
03_Material_Detail.recommended_prompt: Tactile architectural detail focus on {material} facade, 35mm architectural lens, soft daylight filtering, macro architectural photography, preserve building geometry, no text or logos

04_Drone_Aerial.name: Drone Aerial Orbit Masterplan
04_Drone_Aerial.recommended_motion: controlled aerial reveal (small amplitude, slow speed)
04_Drone_Aerial.known_limitations: single-frame geometry limitation - no large orbit / 360 rotation
04_Drone_Aerial.recommended_prompt_template: High altitude drone orbit sweeping architectural masterplan context, golden hour daylight, crisp architectural presentation, stable camera flight trajectory, preserve building geometry
04_Drone_Aerial.camera_style: aerial drone orbit, slow arc, stable trajectory
04_Drone_Aerial.recommended_prompt: High altitude drone orbit sweeping architectural masterplan context, golden hour daylight, crisp architectural presentation, stable camera flight trajectory, preserve building geometry, no text or logos

05_Slow_Walkthrough.name: Pedestrian Eye-Level Walkthrough
05_Slow_Walkthrough.recommended_motion: very slow forward push in / subtle tracking (small amplitude, slow speed)
05_Slow_Walkthrough.known_limitations: SINGLE_FRAME_DEEP_WALKTHROUGH_LIMITATION - future: multi-reference, first+last keyframes, segmented clip stitching
05_Slow_Walkthrough.recommended_prompt_template: Pedestrian eye level walkthrough through {space}, steady camera movement, soft daylighting, architectural interior photography, preserve building geometry, 4k resolution
05_Slow_Walkthrough.camera_style: pedestrian eye level walkthrough, steady camera
05_Slow_Walkthrough.recommended_prompt: Pedestrian eye level walkthrough through {space}, steady camera movement, soft daylighting, architectural interior photography, preserve building geometry, no text or logos
